_readme: 2. Add one entry to the 'items' list below for each photo.
src      (required) path to the file, e.g. assets/img/work/ring.jpg
category (required) one of the category ids listed above: animal, human, milk
alt      (optional) short plain description of the photo, for screen readers
caption  (optional) a few words shown when someone hovers the photo
feature  (optional) set to true on ONE photo to use it in the big well on the home page
